facts.fact: TheNigeriaLawyer reports that the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, led by Commissioner and CEO Dr Vincent Olatunji, is the statutory authority regulating data privacy and is acting.

NDPC chief Olatunji said the commission had investigated more than 240 breach cases, issued over 20 major remediation orders and named more than 1,900 non-compliant organisations in public notices, over about three years.
